findings.passage: “When people begin to question the integrity of our elections, trust in the government starts to erode,” Assemblymember Leticia Castillo, R-Corona, told reporters. “That’s exactly why we need voter ID in California.”
findings.note: Quoted by The Center Square (republished on Just the News) at a Capitol press conference about the voter ID ballot initiative. She links voter ID to trust in elections. Article dated 2026-03-03; the press conference was the Tuesday of that week.

findings.passage: “They’d tell me, ‘You have to check IDs. How do you know it’s really me?’ ” Castillo said.
findings.note: Quoted by The Center Square. She describes voters she met while working at the polls who offered their IDs even where not required.
